bio.text: I began studies in Architecture at the University of Arizona, then I switched to earn a BFA in Visual Communications and Minor in Media Arts.
Living in the UK and telecommuting to the US. Also spent time being a roadie for a metal band touring England.
Started working for PUMA's international office and switched over to Almighty and worked on New Balance projects.
Worked for SYRUP, B-Reel and Local Projects and loved being in Brooklyn
Island life and telecommuting to work
